SPARKLING WINE
PIPER SONOMA BRUT NV
Inspired by
the grand tradition of Piper-Heidsieck
Champagne, this cuvée of California-grown Chardonnay
own. Spiral chains of tiny bubbles reveal the historic
afforded to all truly fine sparkling wines. With a robust
cheer every festive occasion.
WHITE WINE
JEKEL VINEYARDS ARROYO SECO
GRAVELSTONE CHARDONNAY 1994
Vineyards have been cultivated in the dry gravel soils
along the Arroyo Seco Creek since the 1830s - long
before the modern era of winegrowing in California's
Monterey County. It is there that Jekel Chardonnay
vines produce sumptuous dry white wines
the 1994 vintage expressing a bold boxwood, apple
and pear bouquet,
along
with lingering flavors
of honey and toasty oak. Topping the wine's 1996 list
of accolades are a gold medal and Best of Show
at the Monterey Wine Competition. A truly delicious
dry white wine.
RED WINE
MIRASSOU MONTEREY
CABERNET SAUVIGNON 1992
The Mirassou family is America's oldest commercial
winemaking heritage. Their 1992 Cabernet Sauvignon
is delicious. full-bodied dry red wine that exemplifies
the art and craft which has been the tradition at their
large Santa Clara Valley estate since 1854. A wine of
deep scarlet-ruby color, this Cabernet has a generous
bouquet of black currants and tobacco leaves, with
mature tannins and lingering cherry-cedar flavor
winning a gold medal
at the 1996 New World
International Wine Competition.
603W099 4/97

THE SALAD CART
Hearts of Romaine Lettuce with Parmesan Cheese and Croutons,
with a choice of fresh Herb Vinaigrette or Sour Cream Herb Dressing
ENTREES
CHATEAUBRIAND
Salt and Pepper crusted Filet of Beef enhanced by a smothered Onion Demi-Glace,
served with roasted Root Vegetables and Spinach Garlic Mashed Potatoes
VEAL WITH JERKY SAUCE
Veal Medallions with a hearty Sauce of Beef Jerky and Red Bell Peppers,
dried Corn and Rice Pilaf and a medley of sauteed Zucchini, Squash and Red Bell Peppers
BALSAMIC MARINADE CHICKEN
Grilled marinated Chicken Breast with Red Onion and Fennel Saute on Tomato Rice Pilaf
DINE UPON REQUEST™
American Airlines is pleased to offer any of the entrees listed below, complete
with assorted fine Cheeses, presented all at once, at any time you wish during the flight.
Veal with Jerky Sauce • Balsamic Marinade Chicken
Please notify your flight attendant with your preferred time of dining
and we will be happy to accommodate your specific needs.

CONDIMENT TRAY

that allows you to customize the flavors of your entree.
Soy Sauce • Pepper Sauce • Lemon Pepper • Salt Free Seasoning
